summary: Tested Live Location sharing (to_date/to_support) feature end-to-end. Backend pytest (5 tests) and frontend Playwright flow all passed. Admin 'Live locations' tab correctly shows entries shared with support, and the chips/switch behaviour on /dates matches the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_live_target`: inviter_id/recipient_id fields assumed to exist; good defensive 404 on missing. OK.
LiveLocation.jsx: good use of toRef to avoid stale state in watchPosition callback; chip styles update deterministically.
AdminLiveLocations.jsx: polling every 20s - acceptable; no auth gating in component but server-side `get_admin` handles 403.
test_credentials: Admin giftsdates@gmail.com / Admin@12345; User ll_tester@example.com / Test@12345
seed_data_creation: Reused existing booking id 'll-test-1' in date_bookings; updated scheduled_at to now to be inside the live window.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified: POST /api/live-location/booking/{id} with to_date/to_support flags; GET returns other=null when to_date=false; GET /api/admin/live-locations lists support-shared entries from last 3h; non-admin returns 403. Frontend: chips data-testid live-loc-share-date-{id} / live-loc-share-support-{id} toggle styles; live-loc-toggle-{id} is disabled when both chips off; after enabling with Support selected and geolocation granted, admin-live-{dateId}-{userId} appears in Admin > Live locations tab (admin-tab-live).
rca of the issue: N/A - all features working as designed.
